notes: The SL card lasts 72 hours and covers tram 7 to Djurgården and the ferry. Arlanda Express costs 340 SEK (Flygbussarna 130). Cash is not accepted; cards (Swish) are used everywhere.

Summer temperatures are 20-25°C, with daylight from 04:00 to 22:00. At Midsummer (the 3rd Friday of June) everything closes, though Skansen celebrates. You can swim in the archipelago, and boats run to Drottningholm.
Meatballs cost 200 SEK, fika 80-110, restaurants 300-500, museums 150-280. For a tip, round up the bill. The city is expensive, so work out whether the Stockholm Pass (Go City) pays off for museums.
Arrive at Vasa when it opens at 09:00. ABBA tickets are timed and booked online, and the City Hall tour is compulsory. In summer, take the boat to Drottningholm (1 hour); it is a pleasant trip.
Fika culture: kanelbulle (on 4 October, the Cinnamon Bun Day!), kardemummabulle (cardamom bun), prinsesstårta; smörgåsbord, gravlax, and surströmming (fermented herring, for the brave).
Systembolaget (the state liquor store) closes at 20:00 and is shut on Sundays. A beer in a bar costs 80 SEK.

transit.name: SL 72-hour pass + optional Stockholm Pass
transit.why_chosen: Covers metro, bus, tram 7 and the Djurgården ferry; 72 hours costs about 350 SEK
transit.coverage: SL metro, otobüs, banliyö, Djurgården feribotu

stops.name: Stortorget
stops.tips: Medieval square lined with colourful houses. Home to the Nobel Museum and the site of the 1520 bloodbath. Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Royal Palace Stockholm
stops.tips: A 600-room palace: see the State Apartments and the Treasury, and catch the changing of the guard at 12:15 (mounted in summer).

stops.name: Under Kastanjen Gamla Stan
stops.tips: Courtyard café under chestnut trees. Try the meatballs and kanelbulle (cinnamon bun).

stops.name: Mårten Trotzigs Gränd & Prästgatan
stops.tips: The narrowest alley, just 90 cm wide. Look for the rune stone, and escape the tourist crowds of Västerlånggatan.

stops.name: Riddarholmen Church & Monteliusvägen
stops.tips: Royal tombs (summer), then a sunset view of Gamla Stan from the Södermalm cliffs.

backups.name: Nobel Prize Museum
backups.tips: See the Nobel chairs, signed underneath. Swap in for the street wandering.

backups.name: Kaffekoppen Stortorget
backups.tips: Café on the square; time for fika (coffee break).

stops.name: Vasa Museum
stops.tips: A 69 m warship that sank on its maiden voyage in 1628 (98% original). One of the world's best museums; opens at 09:00.

stops.name: Skansen
stops.tips: The world's first open-air museum (1891). Swedish village houses, elk, reindeer, wolves, and dancing in summer.

stops.name: Skansen Solliden Restaurant
stops.tips: Restaurant with a view inside Skansen; try the meatballs.

stops.name: ABBA The Museum
stops.tips: Sing on stage with ABBA. Timed tickets, book online.

stops.name: Rosendals Trädgård
stops.tips: Garden café and bakery with an apple orchard and kanelbulle. Outdoor seating in summer.

backups.name: Nordic Museum
backups.tips: Scandinavian way of life, including Sami culture. Swap in for ABBA.

stops.name: Fotografiska
stops.tips: Photography museum in a former customs house. The rooftop café overlooks the harbour, and it stays open until 23:00.

stops.name: Nytorget & SoFo
stops.tips: Hipster Södermalm: vintage shops and Greta Garbo's old neighbourhood.

stops.name: Meatballs for the People
stops.tips: 14 kinds of meatballs (including elk and reindeer) in SoFo.

stops.name: Skinnarviksberget
stops.tips: The city's highest natural point, with views over Riddarfjärden. Good for a picnic.

stops.name: Mariaberget & Monteliusvägen Sunset
stops.tips: Cliffside walking path with sunset views of City Hall and Gamla Stan.

backups.name: Spritmuseum Djurgården
backups.tips: Museum of snaps and aquavit. Swap in for Fotografiska.

stops.name: Stockholm City Hall
stops.tips: The Nobel banquet is held in the Blue Hall, with mosaics in the Golden Hall. Tour is compulsory; the tower (summer) is 106 m.

stops.name: Drottningholm Palace
stops.tips: Home of the royal family (UNESCO), with a baroque garden and the Chinese Pavilion. Take the 1-hour boat from Stadshuskajen (summer) or the metro and bus.

stops.name: Drottningholm Palace Theatre
stops.tips: 1766 baroque theatre with original stage machinery. Guided tour.

stops.name: Drottningholms Paviljong Café
stops.tips: Café in the palace gardens: smörgås (open sandwich) and fika.

stops.name: Lovön Island Walk
stops.tips: Walk along the shore of Lake Mälaren. Return by boat or bus.

backups.name: Millesgården Lidingö
backups.tips: Terraced garden museum of the sculptor Carl Milles. Swap in for Drottningholm.

backups.name: Stadshuskällaren
backups.tips: Nobel menu (from past years) in the City Hall cellar.

stops.name: Waxholmsbolaget Strömkajen
stops.tips: Archipelago ferry (30,000 islands). Vaxholm takes 1 hour; the Båtluffarkortet 5-day pass costs 995 SEK.

stops.name: Vaxholm Fortress
stops.tips: Island fortress and museum, plus the town's wooden houses.

stops.name: Vaxholms Hembygdsgård Café
stops.tips: Seaside café; try the prawn sandwich (räksmörgås).

stops.name: Grinda Island
stops.tips: Nature reserve island: swim off the rocks (summer), hike, and eat at Grinda Wärdshus. Return ferry at 18:00.

backups.name: Fjäderholmarna
backups.tips: The island closest to the city, 20 minutes away, with craftspeople and a restaurant.

stops.name: Östermalms Saluhall
stops.tips: 1888 gourmet food hall: fish at Lisa Elmqvist, and fika.

stops.name: Uppsala Cathedral
stops.tips: 40 minutes by train. Scandinavia's largest cathedral, with the tomb of Gustav Vasa and Linnaeus.

stops.name: Gustavianum & University
stops.tips: 1620 anatomical theatre at Uppsala University.

stops.name: Güntherska Hovkonditori Uppsala
stops.tips: 1870 pastry shop; try prinsesstårta (princess cake with green marzipan).

stops.name: Gamla Uppsala
stops.tips: Viking royal burial mounds and a museum. Take bus 2, then the train back.

backups.name: Sigtuna
backups.tips: Sweden's oldest town (980), with rune stones. Swap in for Uppsala.

stops.name: Rålambshovsparken
stops.tips: Waterfront park with views of Västerbron bridge.

stops.name: Vete-Katten
stops.tips: 1928 pastry shop: kanelbulle and semla (February), for a farewell fika.

stops.name: Drottninggatan & Sergels Torg
stops.tips: Pedestrian shopping street. Visit NK and Kulturhuset, and pick up a Dala horse as a souvenir.

stops.name: Arlanda Express Centralen
stops.tips: 20-minute express train. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Hallwyl Museum
backups.tips: Free 1898 palace-home. Swap in for shopping.
